correctness.rationale: Effective degree-2 Hanf reduction applies to every fixed sentence. All interior binary windows occur at least the Hanf threshold with exponentially high probability by independent disjoint seed blocks. The only nontruncated types occur at endpoints; their exact joint law is independent-uniform for agreeing endpoint signs and reversed-coupled for opposite signs. Finite boundary enumeration determines each probability and dyadic spectrum; prefix formulas achieve all dyadics. Exact distinct total-variation is calculated from the size of the injective code image. Standalone finite checker completed 548 tests.
